label: William L. Rowe, The Problem of Evil and…: Some being is jointly omniscient, omnipotent and wholly…
locator: p. 335 introductory distinction between narrow and broad theism
interpretation: Records the narrow theistic thesis whose denial is the argument’s conclusion, not a claim that Rowe endorses it. The three attributes are joint; no equivalence with every broader deity conception or the full Catholic theory is asserted.
